readerCopy.body: The old story may be easiest to believe exactly where the facts are hardest to face. Neptune square the South Node can make a familiar fantasy, excuse, longing, or escape route especially tempting when reality is disappointing. You may tell yourself the person has changed, the plan will somehow work this time, or the old dream only failed because the timing was wrong. Hope is not the problem. Reusing a comforting explanation instead of checking what is true now is.
